name: Tic Tac Toe
tagline: Tic Tac Toe: Play offline, with friends.
blurb: Tic Tac Toe is the ultimate game of strategy and fun!
description:
Tic Tac Toe is the ultimate game of strategy and fun! Play offline against a challenging AI, compete with a friend on the same device. Customize your game with 3, 4, or 5-sized boards, switch between dark and light themes, and enjoy a minimalist design with elegant UIs. Our game is open source, and you can view the game's source code in the in-app settings page. The game is designed with a minimalist approach, featuring elegant and user-friendly interfaces. Enjoy smooth and immersive transition animations for every element of the game, making your gaming experience visually pleasing.

Tic Tac Toe is built on the Flutter framework, which ensures a smooth and responsive user experience.

Download now!
